SELECT q.QUESTION_ID, q.MEMBER_ID, qm.NAME as MEMBER_NAME, q.CASE_ID, q.TITLE, q.CONTENT, q.CASE_TYPE, q.ASSIGNED_LAWYER, q.STATUS, q.CREATED_AT, q.UPDATED_AT, a.ANSWER_ID, a.CONTENT as ANSWER_CONTENT, a.CREATED_AT as ANSWER_CREATED_AT, a.LAWYER_ID, a.IS_ADOPTED, m.NAME as LAWYER_NAME, att.ATTACH_ID, att.ORIG_NAME, att.SAVE_PATH, att.FILE_SIZE, att.MIME_TYPE FROM TB_QUESTION q LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MEMBER qm ON q.MEMBER_ID = qm.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ANSWER a ON q.QUESTION_ID = a.QUESTION_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON a.LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON l.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT att ON q.QUESTION_ID = att.REF_ID AND att.REF_TYPE = 'QUESTION' WHERE q.QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} ORDER BY a.IS_ADOPTED DESC, a.CREATED_AT ASC
